goal: Produce the traceable v0.92 identity-evidence map consumed by an explicitly allocated v0.93 governance owner.
required_outcome: A row-level map from accepted v0.92 artifacts to allowed v0.93 use, redacted projection, forbidden inference, unresolved decision, and named consumer.
task_boundary: Author the WP-19 handoff map and evidence-grounded ADR-plan update without assigning citizenship, standing, rights, duties, polis authority, or final milestone handoff.
plan_summary: Verify #5834, #5835, and the v0.93 allocation; inventory exact accepted artifacts; author consumer, redaction, forbidden-inference, and unresolved-decision columns; update ADR 0033 planning without acceptance; validate completeness and review from producer/consumer perspectives.
review_scope: Review the WP-19 evidence map, handoff plan, ADR-plan update, validation proof, and exact candidate paths for source traceability, named consumer authority, redaction, explicit blockers, and no governance overclaim.
operator_constraints: A real v0.93 allocation and accepting owner are required
Missing v0.92 evidence remains unavailable rather than implicitly approved
Proposed ADR text is not accepted architecture
Release the preparation claim before handoff

authority_boundary: WP-19 owns the evidence map and ADR planning update
v0.93 owns citizenship, standing, rights, duties, and governance implementation
WP-23/WP-30 own final milestone handoff after quality and ceremony
initial_assumptions: #5834 supplies the integrated birthday review packet
A v0.93 allocation names the accepting consumer

non_goals: Citizenship, standing, rights, duties, or legal/moral-status decisions
Accepting an ADR by editing the plan

invariants: Every handoff row resolves to exact evidence or an explicit blocker
Every allowed use has a named v0.93 consumer
Private inputs expose only governed projections
Birthday evidence never establishes governance authority by itself
risks: v0.93 allocation may be absent or vague
Handoff prose may imply citizenship or standing
Evidence could drift between draft and review
stop_conditions: A required source cannot be safely projected
replan_triggers: ADR numbering or promotion policy changes

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every required identity/continuity artifact maps to exact evidence or an explicit blocker.
AC-2: Every row names allowed v0.93 use, forbidden inference, redaction posture, unresolved decision, and accepting owner.
AC-3: ADR 0033 remains proposed and source-grounded; no governance/citizenship completion is claimed.
AC-4: Completeness, path, redaction, and forbidden-governance-claim validation pass.
AC-5: Exact-head producer/consumer review has no unresolved actionable finding.

steps.action: Inventory exact v0.92 evidence and author the row-level handoff map
Update ADR 0033 planning and unresolved decisions without acceptance
Run completeness, path, redaction, and forbidden-inference checks

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove every required source row resolves to exact evidence or a blocker and names a consumer.
Reject implicit approval, private-state exposure, ADR acceptance, citizenship, standing, and governance-completion claims.
Prove clean patch structure before producer/consumer exact-head review.

review_prompts: Does every row cite exact accepted v0.92 evidence or an explicit blocker?
Is the v0.93 owner and allowed use concrete without granting governance authority?
Can any receipt, birthday, continuity, or proposed ADR be misread as citizenship or standing?
Are private inputs represented only through governed projections?
